list.name: character
list.label: Character
list.query: SELECT name FROM characters ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.name AS Name, c.level AS Level, CASE c.race WHEN 1 THEN 'Human' WHEN 2 THEN 'Orc' WHEN 3 THEN 'Dwarf' WHEN 4 THEN 'Night Elf' WHEN 5 THEN 'Undead' WHEN 6 THEN 'Tauren' WHEN 7 THEN 'Gnome' WHEN 8 THEN 'Troll' WHEN 10 THEN 'Blood Elf' WHEN 11 THEN 'Draenei' ELSE c.race END AS Race, CASE c.class WHEN 1 THEN 'Warrior' WHEN 2 THEN 'Paladin' WHEN 3 THEN 'Hunter' WHEN 4 THEN 'Rogue' WHEN 5 THEN 'Priest' WHEN 6 THEN 'Death Knight' WHEN 7 THEN 'Shaman' WHEN 8 THEN 'Mage' WHEN 9 THEN 'Warlock' WHEN 11 THEN 'Druid' ELSE c.class END AS Class, c.zone AS `Zone id`, ROUND(c.money / 10000) AS Gold, SEC_TO_TIME(c.totaltime) AS Played, IF(c.online, 'yes', 'no') AS Online FROM characters c WHERE c.name = '$character'

panels.title: Event history (felworld_events, newest first)
panels.description: WPvP lifecycle and LLM tool invocations recorded for this character. Retention: Felworld.Events.RetentionDays.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.time AS Time, e.event_type AS Event, e.details AS Details FROM felworld_events e JOIN characters c ON c.guid = e.guid WHERE c.name = '$character' ORDER BY e.time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Memories (mod-llm scratchpad)
panels.description: What this bot has remembered via its remember/forget tools, live from the DB.

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.updated_at AS Updated, m.slug AS Memory, m.content AS Content, s.name AS About FROM mod_llm_memory m JOIN characters c ON c.guid = m.bot_guid LEFT JOIN characters s ON s.guid = m.subject_guid WHERE c.name = '$character' ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC

SELECT h.created_at AS Time, IF(h.speaker = 1, b.name, p.name) AS Speaker, IF(h.speaker = 1, p.name, b.name) AS `To`, h.message AS Message FROM mod_llm_history_pair h JOIN characters b ON b.guid = h.bot_guid JOIN characters p ON p.guid = h.player_guid WHERE b.name = '$character' OR p.name = '$character' ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT 100
